newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent hits new low near close on long-covering.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent hits new low near close on long-covering.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures slipped back into the red and touched a new session low shortly before the close as a fall in NYMEX heating oil encouraged locals to liquidate their positions, brokers said.
"There's no news out there, heating oil is coming off. People went long on the highs and now they're getting out," said one dealer.
Jan Brent was trading 22 cents down at $23.55 a barrel at 1947 GMT, having just brushed a new low of $23.46.
The contract was tracking NYMEX futures which at first shrugged off bearish weekly inventory data, but later struggled at key resistance and fell sharply.
